scene.prompt: Medieval Paris on the Seine: Île de la Cité with Notre-Dame, timber-framed houses on the bridges, wheat fields and vineyards around
Medieval London on the Thames: the Tower, old St Paul's spire, London Bridge lined with houses, ships at the wharves
Medieval Florence on the Arno: stone family towers, the cathedral and its great dome, Tuscan hills with olive groves and cypresses
Medieval Cologne on the Rhine: the unfinished cathedral with a wooden crane on its tower, many church spires, river barges and city walls
Medieval Toledo on a rocky hill above the Tagus gorge: the cathedral, synagogues and mudéjar brick towers, dry hills with olive trees
